title: Binance Margin Adds ASR, ATM, FIO, JUV, WAN & More BTC, FDUSD and USDC Pairs
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Margin has added  AS Roma Fan Token (ASR), Atletico de Madrid Fan Token (ATM), FIO Protocol (FIO), Juventus Fan Token (JUV) and Wanchain (WAN)  as new borrowable and collateral assets on Cross and Isolated Margin, as well as new BTC, FDUSD and USDC trading pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin.  Cross Margin Isolated Margin New Trading Pairs ASR/USDT ,  ATM/USDT ,  ENA/BTC ,  ENA/FDUSD ,  FIO/USDT ,  JUV/USDT ,  LTC/USDC ,  NEAR/USDC ,  WAN/USDT ASR/USDT ,  ATM/USDT ,  ENA/BTC ,  ENA/FDUSD ,  JUV/USDT New Borrowable Assets ASR, ATM, FIO, JUV, WAN ASR, ATM, JUV New Collateral Assets Explore Binance Margin Now! Binance Margin strives to enhance user trading experience by continuously reviewing and expanding the list of trading choices offered on the platform, allowing for greater diversification of user portfolios and flexibility with trading strategies.  Notes: Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates.
